name: ai-powered-analytics-dashboard
description: AI-Powered Analytics Dashboard - Real-time analytics platform with ML insights

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web,ml "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.python:setup: python3 -m venv python-ml/.venv && python-ml/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python-ml/.venv/bin/pip install -r python-ml/requirements.txt
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run python:setup && npm run db:setup
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
